metadata.title: Scalar curvature rigidity of small spherical caps with arbitrary fill-ins
metadata.abstract: We prove an analogue of Min-Oo's conjecture for sufficiently small spherical caps in the unit round sphere. For every dimension $n\ge3$, there exists $r_*(n)>0$ such that the following holds for every round cap of radius $0<r\le r_*(n)$: any smooth compact connected oriented Riemannian fill-in with the same intrinsic boundary metric and with scalar curvature and outward boundary mean curvature at least those of the cap is isometric to the cap.
